reason: A foreign shared-GPU process previously grew to approximately 27 GiB between 30-second monitor polls and OOM-killed bank generation on an unsaved prompt. The bank recovered atomically, but the polling interval left an avoidable race that would be more costly during training.

change.details: Reduce the active-child foreign-GPU polling interval from 30 seconds to 5 seconds. The two-check capacity admission protocol remains 60 seconds per check.

scope: Pre-outcome shared-resource safety correction. It changes only how quickly the supervisor yields to unrelated GPU work.
